svg.aria-label: The format-convert mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Phase 7 Formatter: LaTeX, DOCX through Pandoc, PDF or Markdown; journal formatting; citations between APA 7, Chicago, MLA, IEEE and Vancouver (agent); Hard gate: an unresolved citation-provenance marker in the input? (question); Output refused (stop); Final checklist: content, format, required elements; word count within 1 percent; compile errors fixed, warnings accepted (agent); Formatted document (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake agent: config.md [D24]; the targets, the citation style, the venue and its limits, the format profile, the cover letter; a .md, .docx or .bib found by search [AQ] [4.A R2-20] (stop); Session: pandoc makes the .tex of a .md or .docx in the manuscript's folder with a relative media folder, never over a file; a .docx reaches no PDF [4.A D10] [4.A R1-21] (script); Session: copies the folder to convert/ before any patch; when the citation style stays, compiles it for the numbers of references and citations, whether or not the .tex names a .bib [4.A R1-23] [4.A R2-1] (script); Formatter, first start: the format-convert patch, and the format-convert-copy patch too when the style stays; format-report.md, refs.bib, the cover letter [AY] [4.A R1-23] [4.A R2-9] [4.A R2-33] (ruled); Formatter, same start: a missing required element gets a placeholder in the .tex, a missing DOI only a line in the report; the AI disclosure stays with the draft writer [AD9] [4.A R1-8] (ruled); Session: applies the format-convert patches to the manuscript only for latex, another citation style or a venue, else to pdf/; then cite-keys and check-urls [C] [4.A R1-26] (script); A change of the citation style with a DOCX or Markdown target: the session applies the patch to convert/ and compiles it, and the formatter starts again as a fresh agent for the conversion patch in the new style [4.A R2-9] (ruled); Session: latexmk makes the PDF in pdf/ and copies it beside the .tex [AY] (script); Session: applies the copy patches to convert/ and draws each figure to a PNG, kept beside the Markdown [4.A R1-22] [4.A R2-8] (script); Session: reference_docx.py writes the reference .docx when none is held, pandoc makes DOCX and Markdown with -s [4.A R1-24] [4.A R2-12] (script); Session: the counts of headings, figures, tables, rows, columns, cite commands, entries and words of each output, no threshold [4.A item 6] [4.A R2-21] [4.A R2-23] (script); Session: the figure paths and the abstract's first words [4.A item 6] [4.A R2-23] (script); Session: appends the commands it ran to format-report.md [4.A R2-26] (script); Formatted documents and the report (agent); A .bib given: no formatter and none of the steps above; latex and bibtex with the style's .bst, or a CSL file, make its reference list as <name>-<style>.md and .docx [4.A R2-20] (script); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [C] (stop).

svg.text: academic-paper: the formatter converts and compiles itself, with a hard gate on provenance markers. paper: no provenance gate, no ARS marker stripping and no 1 percent
